steps.title: Configure environment settings
steps.description: Configure compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34, and gradle properties matching Java 17 environment specs.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json file defining app name as Local Qwen AI and package name com.localqwenai.app.

steps.title: Set up permissions and configuration in Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with Internet permissions and set android:usesCleartextTraffic to true for local network connections.

steps.title: Create Gradient Background Asset
steps.description: Design layout background gradient_bg.xml with modern light-cyan tones.

steps.title: Create User Message Bubble Layout
steps.description: Design custom shape user_bubble.xml with rich teal color and rounded corners aligned to the right.

steps.title: Create Assistant Message Bubble Layout
steps.description: Design custom shape bot_bubble.xml with neutral white background and light teal border aligned to the left.

steps.title: Create Dialog Settings Layout
steps.description: Create dialog_settings.xml configuration dialog for Server URL and System Instructions input elements.

steps.title: Create Activity Main Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml consisting of a custom App bar, a ScrollView for chat messages, and a sticky input block at the bottom.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity and SharedPreferences
steps.description: Establish MainActivity.java, binding interface items and initializing default server settings.

steps.title: Implement Settings Panel Callback
steps.description: Hook up standard AlertDialog to let users dynamically save API server URLs and custom System Instructions.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Message Addition Elements
steps.description: Code layout injection methods to add message widgets into scroll layout with automatic bottom-alignment scrolling.

steps.title: Develop POST Request Async Thread
steps.description: Program HttpURLConnection logic to post prompt to /chat endpoint, reading returned job token and initializing poll routines.

steps.title: Create Interval Polling Logic
steps.description: Program a 2-second safe Handler loop querying /job/{job_id} until completed or error statuses return.

steps.title: Handle Processing and Validation States
steps.description: Apply interface locking to block multi-submissions while a task runs, handling visual states robustly.

steps.title: Building Local Qwen AI
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug validation and output final package.
